sentence: The review step runs at most max_edit_rounds edit rounds, the release step at most release_edits, and the run always ends.

questions.ask: What should happen with max_edit_rounds = 0: no edit, but does the release step still run?
questions.code_today: No review round runs; settle and the release audit still run.

sentence: After a lost editor call, nothing reflects, keeps, settles, audits or edits again, and the floor blocks with no fallback.

questions.ask: What should happen if the call is lost in the release step after an earlier release edit was kept?
questions.code_today: The run blocks; the kept release draft does not stand.

questions.ask: What should happen if the provider returns status failed instead of raising?
What should happen if the response is incomplete (cut off) after a partial patch?
questions.code_today: Not lost: the partial edit is reflected and can be kept.

sentence: The review rounds stop after a round that the accept rule did not keep, that changed no file, and whose editor finished its session.

questions.ask: What should happen if the editor hit its turn limit (or made no tool calls), changed no file, and the round was not kept: another round, or stop?
questions.code_today: Another round runs from the same draft and findings (TLC witness; replayed on the real loop).
questions.looks: matches the code's docstring; the PR-body claim C15 omits 'finished', so the claim overstates

sentence: No edit round, review or release, starts while a floor finding that no writable file holds remains.

questions.ask: What should happen if an edit creates an unfixable floor finding?
questions.code_today: Under LastClean the edit is kept, the next round does not start, and settle can restore an earlier clean draft; under StrictImprovement the edit is reverted (a new deterministic key).

sentence: finish is refused while a code check reports a blocking finding, at most max_finish_refusals (3) times; after that it is accepted and finished_with_blocking records it.

questions.ask: What should happen if the only blocking findings are ones no writable file holds?
questions.code_today: finish is still refused up to 3 times, spending turns on a finding the editor cannot fix.

questions.ask: Should a confirmed model finding also block finish?
questions.code_today: No: finish reads only the code checks.

sentence: The floor releases only a draft with no floor finding, and a fallback only when the code checks find no floor finding on it.

questions.ask: What should happen if the fallback passes the code checks but would fail the release audit?
questions.code_today: The fallback stands: only the code checks judge it.
